set.reason: The definition and notation of an algebraic expression use letters standing for numbers.
Writing a symbolic expression requires interpreting the operation notation and the expression being produced.
This target explicitly asks for the justification of transposition, which is applying the same addition/subtraction to both sides.
After eliminating one unknown the procedure solves a one-variable linear equation; only this solving component is claimed.
Substitution introduces the reduction-to-one-variable idea, but adding equations to cancel an unknown is justified independently by equality operations.
The reduction and back-substitution leave one-variable linear equations that must be solved; this is not a claim that every route must name transposition.

Fraction division prepares ratio values with fractional terms. The target expressly permits a simple ratio, and a whole-number pair such as 6 to 3 needs only ordinary division; no fraction-by-fraction division is universal.

set.description: 当某未知数的系数相等或相反时，把两个方程相加或相减消去该未知数。
set.name: Elimination by Addition and Subtraction

set.description: 把含未知数的项移到一边、常数项移到另一边（移项要变号），再合并同类项、系数化为 1。
set.name: Solving Equations by Transposing Terms and Combining Like Terms
set.nameZh: 移项与合并同类项解方程

criteria: 能选择便于代入的方程
能正确求出方程组的解
set.description: 把一个方程变形用一个未知数表示另一个，代入另一个方程消元，转化为一元一次方程。
set.name: Elimination by Substitution

set.description: 把方程一边化为 0，另一边分解成一次因式的积，利用“若 ab=0 则 a=0 或 b=0”求解。
set.name: Factoring Method
scopeNotes: Factoring here is an equation-solving procedure, not the entire factor-sign method for inequalities.

set.description: (a±b)²=a²±2ab+b²，可用图形面积解释。
set.name: Perfect Square Formula

criteria: 能说出除以一个分数等于乘它的倒数
能算出分数除法并约分
set.description: 会计算分数除以分数，等于乘除数的倒数。
set.name: Fraction division

criteria: 能用字母表示数量和运算律
set.description: 用字母表示数、运算律和公式，体会从具体到一般的抽象过程。
set.name: Using Letters to Represent Numbers

set.reason: The definition and notation of an algebraic expression use letters standing for numbers.
Writing a symbolic expression requires interpreting the operation notation and the expression being produced.
This target explicitly asks for the justification of transposition, which is applying the same addition/subtraction to both sides.
After eliminating one unknown the procedure solves a one-variable linear equation; only this solving component is claimed.
Substitution introduces the reduction-to-one-variable idea, but adding equations to cancel an unknown is justified independently by equality operations.
The reduction and back-substitution leave one-variable linear equations that must be solved; this is not a claim that every route must name transposition.

Fraction division prepares ratio values with fractional terms. The target expressly permits a simple ratio, and a whole-number pair such as 6 to 3 needs only ordinary division; no fraction-by-fraction division is universal.

criteria: 能说出比的前项除以后项是比值
能求一个简单的比的比值
set.description: 理解比表示两个数相除的关系，比的前项除以后项叫做比值。
set.name: Meaning of Ratios

criteria: 能列出简单数量关系的代数式
set.description: 把文字叙述的数量关系用代数式表示，如和、差、倍、比多比少。
set.name: Writing Algebraic Expressions

criteria: 能判断一个式子是否是代数式
set.description: 用运算符号把数或字母连接而成的式子叫代数式，掌握省略乘号、分数线书写等规范。
set.name: The Concept and Standard Notation of Algebraic Expressions
